scope.note: Record the target boundaries and observed change scope.

product-fit.note: Record product facts, discovery answers or assumptions, and selected design rationale.

component-depth.note: Record the working signature component, real states, and product-specific information model.

responsive.note: Record actual viewport widths, screenshots, findings, and rechecks.

interaction.note: Exercise the primary task, keyboard controls, and relevant recovery states.

accessibility.note: Record actual focus, labeling, contrast, keyboard, and reduced-motion checks; state limits.

motion.note: This template assumes static work; set motion true and check the implemented behavior when animations exist.

performance.note: Measure the actual output and record the method, scope, and justified budget.

webgl.note: This template assumes no WebGL; set webgl true and verify disposal and fallback when used.
